## STS2.ModAnalyzers.RitsuLib

Roslyn analyzers for Slay the Spire 2 mods on STS2-RitsuLib. See repository [README.md](../../README.md) for rule IDs
and packaging.

Rule set parallels [StS2ModAnalyzers](https://github.com/Alchyr/StS2ModAnalyzers) where applicable, with
RitsuLib-specific registration checks.
